plan.type: Additional sensitivity after review of shared source processing pools; not an original prespecified primary analysis.
plan.population: Keep original one-selected-batch per individual and each existing endpoint eligibility; >=20 target cells for IFN and >=10 people per arm.
variants: Original age/sex/ancestry/cohort design with CR1 by source batch_cov and t(G-1) inference.
Age/sex/ancestry/source batch_cov fixed effects with CR1 by batch_cov and t(G-1) inference; processing cohort omitted because nested.
plan.CR1_correction: G/(G-1)*(N-1)/(N-K), where K is full-rank design width.
plan.multiplicity: BH separately within each pre-existing endpoint family and sensitivity variant; unavailable planned state IFN tests enter as P=1.
plan.validation: Independent manual grouped-score covariance for every estimable model and leave-one-pool-out point estimates for key endpoints.
plan.limits: Approximately 20 clusters; t intervals are finite-cluster approximations, not exact or unbiased guarantees. Observational within-source associations, not independent replication.

semantics.source_author_code_evidence: Author code uses batch_cov to select the multiplexed label dmx_YS-JY-22_pool6 and separately plots Processing_Cohort (cells 7, 8 and 20).
semantics.paper_processing: 23 multiplexed pools profiled across four processing batches; donor identity recovered by genotype demultiplexing.
semantics.local_field_mapping: batch_cov identifies source multiplexed pools and is nested in the four Processing_Cohort values (inventory field cohort); 20 pools are retained by the unchanged one-source-batch-per-individual selection. The mapping is supported jointly by author code, source metadata and the primary paper.
